_not_in_this_slice: items_gifts.json and events.json (spec S3-4 slice 2, NEEDS DESIGN): gifts, marts, TM gifts and scripted events are NOT here, so an absent list is not 'none'; tools/make_chapter_pack.py and its W7 adversarial pass are the next slice
_reader: no loader reads this file yet; check_fairness.py does not glob knowledge/world (fact 2), and nothing in ai_player's play code may read it until a loader and a KNOWLEDGE_FIELDS classification exist
_also_uses: trainers.json and maps.json (their _files: parties, the map scripts' battles)
_measured: null: A6's chapter_priors.json (spec S3-3) is not generated yet (it waits for the AI's loader); when it is, this block is copied from it and labelled source: 'bot corpus'

_excluded.why: a boss-class trainer that no map script battles

_notes.fight: groups a boss's variants (a rival's gender and starter); campaign.json's boss names a fight
_notes.order: DERIVED: the order of the first campaign entry whose `fights` hold this fight (the entry's boss, or the other opponent of a multi battle that its area's scripts set up: TRAINER_BATTLE_SET_TRAINER_A/B); null: no entry fights it (a boss of the post-game, or of an area no entry visits)
_notes.entry: the id of that entry (null with order)
_notes.badge: read from the gym leader's defeat script (setflag FLAG_BADGEnn_GET)
